how far the indexed records may reach from text_start. Six builds place it. Pristine reaches 11568 and runs. Pristine padded to a 12000-byte region still reaches 11568 and runs, ruling out region size. Twelve records carrying the 28-byte name 'Ruinas da Montanha Serdberg' and nothing else reach 11616 and run, ruling out record length. 283 rows budgeted to the old 80-byte slack reach 11648 and run. All 350 rows with that name at 25 bytes reach 11963 and run; the same 350 with it at 28 reach 11999 and crash the save/load screen from the title menu and in game. Relocating the entry to 19 sectors changes nothing either way. The true boundary is in 11964-11999. Every European release ships this bank far larger (Spain 13403, Italy 13139, Germany 13053, France 12493) on its own executable, so the cap is compiled in per region and their data bounds nothing here.

716 bytes past this resource's pristine outer allocation. 24 token records adding 19 glyphs. Played without issue at this extent. Entered twenty times from a memory-card save with no fault, which is the run count 1337's ladder established as meaningful against a two-in-five failure rate. Play-tested again on the drawn accent marks -- twenty entries from a memory-card save, no fault -- but at an extent below this mark, so the figure is unchanged and this row is verified rather than a candidate. This resource ends within a dozen bytes of that mark, and every change to the drawn accent art recompresses it by a few bytes, so it crosses the line easily: the first drawn set put 127, 133 and 245 over, thinning the marks put only 245 over, reshaping the tilde put 133 and 1015 over, and lightening the circumflex brought all but 245 back. Expect to re-measure after a glyph change rather than to derive.
